            <title><![CDATA[What the Supreme Court's voter-citizenship database decision means for the midterms]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/what-the-supreme-courts-voter-citizenship-database-decision-means-for-the-midterms</link>
            <description><![CDATA[The Supreme Court revived a controversial voter-citizenship database less than two months ahead of the midterm elections. In the ruling, the court sided with the Trump administration, which is seeking to use the Department of Homeland Security's SAVE database to review state voter rolls for potential noncitizens. Geoff Bennett discussed more with Jessica Huseman of Votebeat.]]></description>

            <title><![CDATA[News Wrap: Xi wraps up 3-day state visit with Trump]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/news-wrap-xi-wraps-up-3-day-state-visit-with-trump</link>
            <description><![CDATA[In our news wrap Friday, Chinese President Xi wrapped up a three-day state visit with President Trump that was heavy on pageantry and light on policy announcements, tens of millions of people along the East Coast could see flooding, rough surf and high winds due to a powerful nor'easter and New Jersey's lieutenant governor stepped down amid accusations of sexual harassment and ethics violations.]]></description>

            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/mexicos-foreign-secretary-on-trump-cartel-violence-and-u-s-trade-talks</link>
            <description><![CDATA[President Trump struck the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement in his first term, but threw out that trade agreement after retaking office last year. He imposed steep tariffs on both neighbors and even started a trade war with Canada. To discuss trade talks between the countries, Amna Nawaz spoke with Mexico's foreign secretary, Roberto Velasco Álvarez. ]]></description>

            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/health-care-costs-a-major-concern-for-voters-ahead-of-midterms</link>
            <description><![CDATA[Health care is at the center of a political debate as millions of Americans struggle with rising costs. Enrollment in the marketplaces created by the ACA dropped this year, mainly due to the expiration of federal credits.             <title><![CDATA[Wrongfully detained Iranian American journalist remains jailed in Iran after 2 years]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/wrongfully-detained-iranian-american-journalist-remains-jailed-in-iran-after-2-years</link>
            <description><![CDATA[This week marks two years that Iranian American journalist Reza Valizadeh has been detained in Iran. For a decade, he worked for Radio Farda — an independent, but U.S.-funded Farsi-language news service. During a trip to Iran to visit family, Valizadeh was arrested and sentenced to ten years in prison for "collaborating with a hostile government." Amna Nawaz spoke with his attorney, Ryan Fayhee.]]></description>

            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/syrian-dancer-reflects-on-escaping-isis-and-finding-freedom-through-ballet</link>
            <description><![CDATA[Ahmad Joudeh is a ballet dancer of unusual grace and grit. He was born stateless in a Palestinian refugee camp in Damascus, Syria.             <title><![CDATA[More than 167,000 pounds of meat were recalled. What to know about the state of food safety in the U.S.]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/health/more-than-167000-pounds-of-meat-were-recalled-what-to-know-about-the-state-of-food-safety-in-the-u-s</link>
